playgrounds.title: Playgrounds report
playgrounds.requirements: A volunteer is required to monitor at least 3 playgrounds and devote at least 10 hours to this every week.
playgrounds.whats-new:
The form for filling out reports has been unified for volunteers of all Russian Diaspora programs. Now the site monitoring report must be filled out and sent only once a week, information about all 3 sites must be entered into one report.
There is no need to fill out a route sheet.

1.title: Go to the report creation page
1.link: Follow this link or via the side menu

2.title: Fill in the Excel file using the template
2.link: You can download the template by link
2.hint:
Copy the file to yourself File - Make a copy.
Fill in the table and download as .xlsx file File - Download

3.title: Enter information about three playgrounds
3.fields:
In the Name field, specify the name of the site, for example Playground in Šumice Park. In the Description field, fill in your detailed comment on the playground. In the Result field, enter the link to the playground on Google Maps. The Customer field is not required.
The total number of hours spent across all playgrounds must be at least 10.
Please attach a photo of the playground and a completed Excel file with the playground parameters to the files.

welcome.title: What's new on the portal
welcome.body: A short guide to the desktop, ideas board, leave, tasks, and reports. Take it now or reopen later via the sparkle in the header.

desktop.title: Desktop
desktop.body: Your home hub: active tasks, recent messages, reports, events calendar, and hours timeline — without hunting through the menu.

desktopTasks.title: Tasks on the desktop
desktopTasks.body: Assignments where you are the assignee and the status is not Done yet. Cards created on the Tasks board appear here. “Board →” opens the full kanban.

desktopMessages.title: Messages on the desktop
desktopMessages.body: Inbox preview: reports, reviews, and Ideas & talents. New talent posts land here for everyone — open the link right away.

desktopEvents.title: Upcoming events
desktopEvents.body: Meetings, cleanups, and lectures. The list shows the next dates; click a day to filter. Curators and admins can add events.

desktopReports.title: Reports and remarks
desktopReports.body: Your latest reports. If a moderator or customer left feedback, it shows as a yellow Remark on the card.

reportRemarks.title: Comments on reports
reportRemarks.body: The yellow Remark is review feedback: what to clarify, who the customer should be, where the task came from. Read it and edit the report if needed.

reportCustomer.title: Customer in a report
reportCustomer.body: Every report task needs a customer — the program curator or their acceptance delegate. They accept the work. You cannot pick yourself. Board tasks often fill the customer automatically.

ideas.title: Ideas & talents
ideas.body: Board for finding people, offering help, and project ideas. Publish a card; skills on the right help others find you.

ideasRespond.title: How to take part
ideasRespond.body: On someone else's open card, tap Respond — the author gets a message. Your posts live under My: history, close, and reopen.

leave.title: Leave — why and how
leave.body: Approved days do not count toward the hour quota and do not increase report delay. Pick dates, optional reason — after approval, leave shows in the hours history on the desktop.

tasks.title: Tasks board
tasks.body: The assignee drives the card until Review. The customer can send it back or accept. The deadline starts on the first move. From the board, the task appears on the assignee's desktop.

bell.title: Notifications
bell.body: Quick access to announcements and inbox from the header.

configure.title: Tour settings
configure.body: The wizard is not admin-configurable yet: steps and copy ship with portal updates. This button always reopens the tour. After a big feature wave we bump the tour version so everyone sees it again.

done.title: You're set!
done.body: Use the sparkle in the header anytime you want the guide again.
